posts.reason: Supervisor apps (add-ons) change; not applicable to an integration.

posts.title: Undefined sentinel changes
posts.reason: Integration does not use UNDEFINED/UndefinedType (grep). Revisit only if DeviceInfo field reads are added, since unset fields read as UNDEFINED.

posts.title: Always pass a step_id to flow results
posts.reason: All async_show_form calls in config_flow.py already pass step_id (verified 2026-11-06).

posts.title: Config entry functions now return None
posts.reason: __init__.py async_setup_entry/async_unload_entry return bool. Still supported for custom integrations, no deprecation. Optional cleanup once min HA >= 2026.11: return None and use async_unload_platforms_or_raise.

posts.title: Introducing child devices
posts.reason: Possible enhancement: model CAME gateway sub-parts as child devices instead of via_device_id. Not required; revisit when min HA >= 2026.11.

posts.title: Show form fields based on other fields
posts.reason: Config flow forms have no conditional fields; nothing to adopt.

posts.title: Integrations have categories now
posts.reason: Add the optional `categories` key to manifest.json (HACS action warns when missing, fails on unknown category). Pick from the core category list.

posts.title: Auth providers now opt in to multi-factor authentication
posts.reason: Auth providers only; not applicable.

posts.reason: Developer tool announcement; no code impact.

posts.title: A new home for every contributor

posts.title: DeviceInfo is now a dataclass
posts.reason: entity.py sets self._attr_device_info['translation_key'/'translation_placeholders'] via the dict compatibility layer (to be deprecated), and __init__.py unpacks **gateway_device_info(). Pass translation fields to the DeviceInfo constructor now; switch to async_get_or_create_from_info once min HA >= 2026.11.

posts.title: Removal of RestoreStateData.last_states
posts.reason: No RestoreEntity/RestoreStateData usage.

posts.title: Probatio is our validation engine
posts.reason: Pre-commit guard scripts/check_probatio_migration.py enforces migration once min HA >= 2026.10.

posts.title: Shared config flow abort reasons are translated centrally
posts.reason: strings.json keeps reauth_successful/reconfigure_successful abort keys; async_update_reload_and_abort uses the central domain on 2026.10+. Remove those keys once min HA >= 2026.10.
